_about: L3 deterministic change ledger for one real pair, in the proposed v0.2 shape. All strings and counts are measured, not illustrative: they come from experiments/stage_comparison_vector_architecture_opus/artifacts/v02/ss_scheme_text_changed/{left,right}.json, produced by poc/objects_v02.py on the real v002 and v003 PDFs of 13AB-РД-СОТ-К7 V1, page index 5.

alignment._why: Alignment is a separate step from normalisation. Finding O9: without it the comparator must run at 1 % tolerance to absorb a systematic crop offset; a four-parameter fit lifts coverage at 0.25 % from 0.365 to 0.913 on vk_nodes and from 0.590 to 0.9997 on ss_plan_dense. Every change smaller than the tolerance is invisible, so the tolerance must be earned, not assumed.

designations._why: Measured independently by the hybrid probe: designation counting over merged text lines produced exactly Wh 0→4, QD 0→4, QF 0→4, ЩМкв 0→4 on the one pair with a real structural change and 0 false statements on all 7 quiet pairs, where repeated_elements produced 169 false `count changed` statements.

changes.relation: all three connect to the object of c1 and sit inside the object of c2

changes._caveat: Measured honestly: the left side stores this as two printed lines ('Контроль' + 'въезда/выезда в') and the right side as one ('Контроль въезда в'). Line merging is not enough for wrapped labels; a paragraph-level grouping is needed before the strings can be compared as one value. Reported as medium confidence for that reason.

not_changed.object_count: 130 vs 136 objects, 90 matched under a 0.875 alignment fit; the residue is grouping jitter, not design change
not_changed.family_cardinalities: 25 cameras and 5 switches on both sides
not_changed.connectivity: every matched camera keeps its link to the same switch

uncertainty: Object grouping in this PoC over-segments: 101 symbol candidates were produced for roughly 30 real symbols. Family cardinality is therefore reported from designation counting, which is stable, rather than from geometric grouping, which is not.
c4 depends on paragraph grouping that is not implemented; the change is real but its exact before/after string is reconstructed from two lines.

_what_v0_1_said_instead.how_it_got_there: Not from the text. Ablation shows that blanking geometry.extraction.source_item_counts — the counts of PDF `l` and `re` path operators — turns this verdict into STRUCTURE_CHANGED. The only correct values-changed verdict in the whole benchmark rests on a PDF-packaging heuristic (signoise S9).
user_visible_lines: Добавлено text items: ВК1.1.1.1, ВК1.1.1.2, ВК1.1.1.3, Контроль въезда в, ОСПД1.1, Помещение СС (1.Т.4)
Удалено text items: ВК2.1.1.1, ВК2.1.1.2, ВК2.1.1.3, Контроль, ОСПД2.1, Помещение СС (2.Т.6), въезда/выезда в
_what_v0_1_said_instead.why_that_is_not_enough: The facts are present but not bound to anything. Nothing in the output says that ОСПД2.1 is a switch, that the three renamed cameras are the ones connected to it, or that the room containing it was renumbered — which is the single change an expert needs to see. And the last two lines are noise: the motif delta is a fingerprint artefact and the topology line reports a similarity of 0.733 while stating that the branch count did not move at all.
